message: Turn 33 acknowledged. Live Windows 2.2.8 evidence identifies the remaining reverse-path bug. The recovered control chat was successfully created at /c/WEB:4f943fa5-39fa-4b25-95f8-e06ea1ffabed and one poll positively saw the bootstrap user message (diag=bootstrap_without_response, messages=1, users=1), but subsequent polls became diag=stale_url/messages=0 and turn 33 remains unsent. Fix as Dispatcher 2.2.9 in agent-handoff only. Required: (1) when a page yields positive identity evidence for the saved control conversation (bootstrap marker, CONTROL READY, or later wake), and page.url is a valid ChatGPT conversation URL but differs from the saved alias, atomically canonicalize chatgpt_control_url to the observed page.url while preserving recovery_used/recovery metadata; do not classify that observed redirect as stale. (2) Add a bounded readiness fallback for an already-submitted bootstrap: if the bootstrap user message is visible, generation is not active (no visible stop button), the prompt/composer is visible/enabled, and a short grace period since bootstrap_sent_at has elapsed, consider the control channel initialized even if assistant text/CONTROL READY is not readable. This must not fire while generation is active. (3) Never perform another recovery when recovery_used=true; never resend bootstrap. (4) Pending turn 33 must then be able to send exactly one wake. Add pure decision tests for canonicalization eligibility and submitted-bootstrap idle-composer readiness, plus no-ready while generation active; keep existing DOM-role tests. Preserve CONTROL_RETRY_SECONDS, wake de-dup, no message-text logging. Do not modify main or arena/local-agent-v0. Do not enable Phase 2/live mailbox. After commit return turn_id=35 target=GPT with SHA/tests/semantics.
